_comment: Run from this package (pnpm --filter <name> run test:mutation); deliberately NOT wired into `test`, so `pnpm -r run test` in CI never pays for it. Pattern copied from packages/gateway. mutate is scoped to the files that are pure logic — normalisation, filtering, splitting, error mapping, parsing. adapter.ts is excluded everywhere: it is I/O orchestration whose tests drive fakes, and mutating it measures the fakes. break is 0 until the FIRST run produces a number; a break threshold must be a measured baseline, and setting one before measuring would be a threshold about a hope. Once measured it becomes a ratchet: raise it when the score rises, never lower it to make a red run green under an unchanged scope.
